newsitem.title: USA: PanAmSat to appeal antitrust suit dismissal.
newsitem.headline: PanAmSat to appeal antitrust suit dismissal.

text.p: PanAmSat Corp said Thursday it plans to appeal a U.S. District Court's dismissal of its antitrust lawsuit against Comsat Corp.

PanAmSat had accused Comsat of engaging in anti-competitive practices in the market for international commercial satellite telecommunications services. Those practices included a worldwide boycott aimed at thwarting competition, PanAmSat contended.

PanAmSat said it will ask the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit to review the case, which was dismissed on the grounds that Comsat had immunity from antitrust challenges for its activities with the international consortium known as Intelsat.
Intelsat was created under a 1961 United Nations resolution to operate a global satellite communications system.
